# C389 (inline) — limit_reasons: honest coverage; fetch_item timeout
Rehearsal 2026-10-21 (C388 queueing, real Kaipan): fetch_item:limit_reasons attempt 1 hit the 300s event timeout (needs ~9min), attempt 2 resumed from checkpoint. The rebuilt version had 36 rows vs 54 originally and still claimed coverage 1.0/READY. Cause (verified live): Kaipan getBanReasons returns only the latest reason; 18 of 54 symbols limited up again on 10-21, so their 10-20 entry no longer exists and was silently dropped as future-dated. Fix: provider counts such symbols as overwritten (coverage_count excludes them, partial=True, details), manifest row_count = real rows, registry note, fetch_item timeout 1000s. Real check: live provider run over 15 symbols → 7 overwritten.
